Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Candidate query for the Nivelacija document. Returns every batch eligible for repricing as of an effective date, carrying its as-of price, VAT rate and effective cost. Read-only — creates nothing.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text:
PARAMS (JSON): effectiveDate ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". The date the nivelacija will carry. Defaults to today. samoNulaPDV 1 = only batches whose as-of VAT rate is 0. Default 0 (all eligible batches). artikalId optional — restrict to one article.
RETURNS data: rows array of candidates, one per batch effectiveDate the resolved date, echoed back count rows count
WHY AS-OF AND NOT CURRENT: A nivelacija may be backdated. The price it must show as "stara cijena" is the price in force on its own date, not today's. CijeneStavki is the append-only price-event log; the price as of D is the last event with VaziOd <= D, ordered by VaziOd, TipPrioritet, IzvorBroj. Kalkulacija events carry TipPrioritet 1 and nivelacija events 2, so a same-day nivelacija correctly supersedes the kalkulacija that priced the goods in that morning.
WHY ONE ROW PER EVENT, WALKED: FileMaker SQL has no window functions, so "last event per batch" cannot be expressed in the query. The SELECT returns every event up to the date ordered by batch and sort key, and the loop keeps the last row seen for each batch. Batch base data rides along on every event row so no second lookup or JSON map is needed for it.
QUANTITY IS AS-OF TOO: kolicina is stock on hand ON THE EFFECTIVE DATE, not today — consumption and returns are both bounded by that date. For a backdated document this is the only correct figure: goods sold after the effective date were sold at the new price and must not be revalued.
CONSUMPTION MODEL: same three rules as the Stock Manager. DOO only, Predracun consumes nothing, Reklamacija returns goods and so adds back. Aggregated by batch and document status so the sign is applied here rather than trusting a CASE expression through the SQL layer.
ELIGIBILITY: a batch is a candidate when it has stock on hand at the effective date and carries a kalkulacija. It is deliberately NOT keyed on dates or eras — the VAT cutover in this file is ragged (K-037 on 14.07 has VAT, K-034 on 21.07 does not), so any date rule would fight the data. samoNulaPDV=1 narrows to the pre-VAT stock the first nivelacija exists to lift.

Value.Calculation: Response_AddError ( "COMPANY_NOT_FOUND" ; "Ne mogu pronaći firmu tipa DOO." ; "companyId" ; "{}" ; "" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── ISO string to a native FM date. Anything shorter than 10 characters is treated as absent and falls back to today, so an empty parameter yields a live document rather than a silent 0 date. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Query 1 of 3: every price event up to the effective date, with the batch's base data riding along. Ordered so the LAST row seen for a batch is its as-of price. INNER join to CijeneStavki is the eligibility rule — a batch with no price event has no kalkulacija and is material on the premises, not stock. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT" & " CijeneStavki.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID," & " CijeneStavki.Cijena," & " CijeneStavki.PDVPostotak," & " CijeneStavki.NabavnaCijenaEfektivna," & " CijeneStavki.IzvorID," & " CijeneStavki.IzvorBroj," & " StavkePrimke.Kolicina," & " StavkePrimke.JM," & " StavkePrimke.ForeignKeyArtikalID," & " Artikli.SifraArtikla," & " Artikli.NazivArtikla" & " FROM CijeneStavki" & " JOIN StavkePrimke ON StavkePrimke.PrimaryKey = CijeneStavki.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID" & " JOIN Primke ON Primke.PrimaryKey = StavkePrimke.ForeignKeyPrimkaID" & " JOIN Artikli ON Artikli.PrimaryKey = StavkePrimke.ForeignKeyArtikalID" & " WHERE Primke.ForeignKeyCompanyID = ?" & " AND CijeneStavki.VaziOd <= " & epSQLQuoteDate ( $effDate ) & If ( IsEmpty ( $artikalId ) ; "" ; " AND StavkePrimke.ForeignKeyArtikalID = " & epSQLQuote ( $artikalId ) ) & " ORDER BY CijeneStavki.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID, CijeneStavki.VaziOd, CijeneStavki.TipPrioritet, CijeneStavki.IzvorBroj" ; "useSQLResult=rs_evt" ; $companyId )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Query 2 of 3: consumption as of the effective date, grouped by batch AND document status. The sign lives in the loop, not in a CASE expression — Predracun contributes nothing, Reklamacija adds back. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT" & " InvoiceLines.ForeignKeyStavkaUlazneFakture," & " Invoices.StatusDokumenta," & " SUM ( InvoiceLines.Qty )" & " FROM InvoiceLines" & " JOIN Invoices ON Invoices.PrimaryKey = InvoiceLines.ForeignKeyInvoiceID" & " WHERE Invoices.ForeignKeyCompanyID = ?" & " AND Invoices.Datum <= " & epSQLQuoteDate ( $effDate ) & " GROUP BY InvoiceLines.ForeignKeyStavkaUlazneFakture, Invoices.StatusDokumenta" ; "useSQLResult=rs_con" ; $companyId )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Query 3 of 3: returns to supplier as of the effective date. Separate query rather than a join — consumption and returns are two children of the same batch and joining both at once cross-multiplies every SUM. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT" & " StavkePovrata.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID," & " SUM ( StavkePovrata.Kolicina )" & " FROM StavkePovrata" & " JOIN PovratiDobavljacima ON PovratiDobavljacima.PrimaryKey = StavkePovrata.ForeignKeyPovratID" & " WHERE PovratiDobavljacima.DatumPovrata <= " & epSQLQuoteDate ( $effDate ) & " GROUP BY StavkePovrata.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID" ; "useSQLResult=rs_ret" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Walk the event rows. Rows are ordered by batch then sort key, so a row is the as-of state of its batch whenever the NEXT row belongs to a different batch (or there is no next row). Emit only there, and only when there is stock on hand. ──

Value.Calculation: GetAsNumber ( epSQLResult ( $i ; 6 ; "rs_evt" ) ) - GetAsNumber ( JSONGetElement ( $cons ; $batchId ) ) - GetAsNumber ( JSONGetElement ( $rets ; $batchId ) )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── No Max ( 0 ; … ) clamp here, deliberately. StavkePrimke::QtyAvailable_Calculation clamps and that is exactly what hides over-consumption; a negative quantity is a defect the operator needs to see, not a zero. Such a batch is excluded from the candidate list either way, but it is counted and reported as a warning. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Net and RUC derive, they are never stored on the batch: neto = bruto / ( 1 + pct/100 ), RUC = neto − efektivna nabavna. Written as an integer fraction because a dot decimal literal pastes as an empty calculation on this file's comma-decimal locale. ──

Value.Calculation: Response_AddWarning ( "OVER_CONSUMED" ; $overConsumed & " serija ima negativno stanje na dan " & Right ( "0" & Day ( $effDate ) ; 2 ) & "." & Right ( "0" & Month ( $effDate ) ; 2 ) & "." & Year ( $effDate ) & " — isključene su iz nivelacije." ; "kolicina" ; "{}" ; "" )
